requiredCharactersScope: Characters available across the lowercase and uppercase localized layout, plus the built-in Latin layout. CLDR braces denote sequences, not dedicated multi-letter keys.

_eng.mainExemplar: [a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z]
_eng.notes: The English letters are supplied by the built-in Latin layout. Preserve the existing Russian secondary layout for English-language search and editing.

_rus.mainExemplar: [а б в г д её ж з и й к л м н о п р с т у ф х ц ч ш щ ъ ы ь э ю я]

_arm.mainExemplar: [ա բ գ դ ե զ է ը թ ժ ի լ խ ծ կ հ ձ ղ ճ մ յ ն շ ո չ պ ջ ռ ս վ տ ր ց ւ փ ք օ ֆ]
_arm.notes: Includes the modern Armenian ligature և from the auxiliary exemplar. Its uppercase ԵՒ spans two characters; toggling back must restore the original key.

_bel.mainExemplar: [а б в г д {дж} {дз} е ё ж з і й к л м н о п р с т у ў ф х ц ч ш ы ь э ю я]
_bel.notes: The main-exemplar digraphs дж and дз are entered sequentially. Add the modifier-letter apostrophe ʼ (U+02BC); ASCII apostrophe remains available in punctuation.

_bul.mainExemplar: [а б в г д е ж з и й к л м н о п р с т у ф х ц ч ш щ ъ ь ю я]
_bul.notes: Includes the customary accented pronoun ѝ from the auxiliary exemplar in addition to all 30 main alphabet letters.

_fra.mainExemplar: [aàâ æ b cç d eéèêë f g h iîï j k l m n oô œ p q r s t uùûü v w x yÿ z]

_ger.mainExemplar: [aä b c d e f g h i j k l m n oö p q r s ß t uü v w x y z]
_ger.notes: Includes ä and ß. Unicode default uppercase expands ß to SS, so the lowercase layout must be retained rather than recreated by lowercasing the uppercase output.

_gre.mainExemplar: [αά β γ δ εέ ζ ηή θ ιίϊΐ κ λ μ ν ξ οό π ρ σς τ υύϋΰ φ χ ψ ωώ]
_gre.notes: Includes final sigma ς and all modern Greek accents/diaereses in the main exemplar. Uppercase ΐ and ΰ expand into a base plus combining marks; uppercase sigma cannot distinguish the original σ and ς keys.

_heb.mainExemplar: [א ב ג ד ה ו ז ח ט י כך ל מם נן ס ע פף צץ ק ר ש ת]
_heb.notes: Includes all five final letter forms ך ם ן ף ץ. Hebrew letters have no case; changing case must leave this layout intact.

_hun.mainExemplar: [aá b c {cs} {ccs} d {dz} {ddz} {dzs} {ddzs} eé f g {gy} {ggy} h ií j k l {ly} {lly} m n {ny} {nny} oó öő p r s {sz} {ssz} t {ty} {tty} uú üű v z {zs} {zzs}]
_hun.notes: Digraphs and trigraphs (including doubled forms) are entered as sequences of letter keys. Existing q, w and x keys are retained.

_ita.mainExemplar: [aà b c d eéè f g h iì j k l m n oò p q r s t uù v w x y z]
_ita.notes: Existing additional accented í, ó and ú keys are retained alongside the main exemplar.

_lat.mainExemplar: [a ā b c č d e ē f g ģ h i ī j k ķ l ļ m n ņ o p r s š t u ū v z ž]

_lit.mainExemplar: [aą b c č d eęė f g h iįy j k l m n o p r s š t uųū v z ž]

_pol.mainExemplar: [a ą b c ć d e ę f g h i j k l ł m n ń o ó p r s ś t u w y z ź ż]
_pol.notes: Existing q, v and x keys are retained alongside the main exemplar.

_por.mainExemplar: [aáàâã b cç d eéê f g h ií j k l m n oóòôõ p q r s t uú v w x y z]
_por.notes: Includes ò from the main exemplar; the existing î key is retained.

_rou.mainExemplar: [a ă â b c d e f g h i î j k l m n o p q r s ș t ț u v w x y z]

_spa.mainExemplar: [aá b c d eé f g h ií j k l m n ñ oó p q r s t uúü v w x y z]

_tur.mainExemplar: [a b c ç d e f g ğ h ı iİ j k l m n o ö p r s ş t u ü v y z]
_tur.notes: Keep lowercase ı and i separate. Their uppercase partners are I and İ respectively; İ in the CLDR main exemplar is provided by the uppercase layout, not duplicated in lowercase.

_ukr.mainExemplar: [а б в г ґ д е є ж з и і ї й к л м н о п р с т у ф х ц ч ш щ ь ю я ʼ]
_ukr.notes: Includes the alphabetic apostrophe ʼ (U+02BC) from the main exemplar; ASCII apostrophe remains available in punctuation.

_uzb.mainExemplar: [a b d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v x y z {oʻ} {gʻ} {sh} {ch} ʼ]
_uzb.notes: Enter oʻ, gʻ, sh and ch sequentially. Includes c and both distinct modifier letters: ʻ (U+02BB) for oʻ/gʻ, and ʼ (U+02BC) for the apostrophe.

_ind.mainExemplar: [a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z]
_ind.notes: The complete main exemplar is the 26-letter Latin alphabet; the localized layout must not fall back to Russian merely because it equals the built-in Latin layout.

_vie.mainExemplar: [aàảãáạ ăằẳẵắặ âầẩẫấậ b c d đ eèẻẽéẹ êềểễếệ g h iìỉĩíị k l m n oòỏõóọ ôồổỗốộ ơờởỡớợ p q r s t uùủũúụ ưừửữứự v x yỳỷỹýỵ]
_vie.notes: Includes all 89 main-exemplar characters, including every precomposed tone-marked vowel and đ. Auxiliary f, j, w and z remain available through the built-in Latin layout.

_may.mainExemplar: [a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z]
_may.notes: Malay uses its Latin (Rumi) main exemplar. The localized layout must not fall back to Russian merely because it equals the built-in Latin layout; this is not a Jawi input method.

_dut.mainExemplar: [aáä b c d eéë f g h iíï {ij}{íj́} j k l m n oóö p q r s t uúü v w x y z]
_dut.notes: Enter ij and accented íj́ as sequences of letter keys. U+0301 COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT is required for j́, which has no precomposed Unicode character; display a dotted-circle helper but insert only the combining mark.

_cze.mainExemplar: [aá b c č dď eéě f g h {ch} ií j k l m nň oó p q r ř s š tť uúů v w x yý z ž]
_cze.notes: Enter ch as c followed by h. All main-exemplar precomposed accented letters are available directly.

_swe.mainExemplar: [aà b c d eé f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z å ä ö]
_swe.notes: Includes à and é from the main exemplar as well as the Swedish alphabet ending å, ä, ö.

_aze.mainExemplar: [a b c ç d e ə f g ğ h x ı iİ j k q l m n o ö p r s ş t u ü v y z]
_aze.notes: Use the Latin main exemplar, including ə, x, q, ı and i. The uppercase partners of ı and i are I and İ respectively.

_kaz.mainExemplar: [а ә б в г ғ д е ё ж з и й к қ л м н ң о ө п р с т у ұ ү ф х һ ц ч ш щ ъ ы і ь э ю я]
_kaz.notes: Use the Cyrillic main exemplar, including ә, ғ, қ, ң, ө, ұ, ү, һ and і; this layout does not claim to implement a future Latin-script transition.
